createPhoneCall.name: createPhoneCall
createPhoneCall.description: Create a new outbound phone call using OpenMic AI

fromNumber.description: The number you own in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890)

toNumber.description: The number you want to call in E.164 format (e.g., +0987654321)

overrideAgentId.description: The bot UID to override the default agent

dynamicVariables.description: Key-value pairs to replace in the prompt

callbackUrl.description: Callback URL to receive call events

aiMetadata.description: Places a new outbound AI phone call from one E.164 number to another via OpenMic AI. Use to initiate a voice call programmatically; optionally override the default bot/agent, attach a customer ID, inject dynamic prompt variables, or set a callback URL for call events. Not idempotent — each call dials a new outbound call.

findBot.description: Retrieve details of a specific bot by its UID

uid.description: The unique identifier of the bot

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single OpenMic AI bot by its UID. Use when you already have a bot UID and need its configuration; to discover UIDs or browse bots, use Get Bots instead. Read-only and idempotent.

findCall.name: findCall
findCall.description: Retrieve details of a specific call by its ID

callId.description: The unique identifier of the call

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single OpenMic AI call by its call ID. Use when you already have a call ID and need its record; to discover IDs or browse calls, use Get Calls instead. Read-only and idempotent.

getBots.name: getBots
getBots.description: Retrieve all bots with optional filtering and pagination

createdAfter.description: Filter bots created after this date (ISO 8601 format)

createdBefore.description: Filter bots created before this date (ISO 8601 format)

limit.description: Maximum number of bots to return (1-100)

offset.description: Number of bots to skip for pagination

aiMetadata.description: Lists OpenMic AI bots, with optional filters by name (partial match) and created-after/created-before date range plus limit/offset pagination. With no filters it returns all bots; supply filters to narrow the set. Use to discover bots and their UIDs. Read-only and idempotent.

getCalls.name: getCalls
getCalls.description: Retrieve all calls with optional filtering and pagination

fromDate.description: Filter calls from this date (ISO 8601 format)

toDate.description: Filter calls to this date (ISO 8601 format)

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return (1-100)

offset.description: Number of calls to skip for pagination

aiMetadata.description: Lists OpenMic AI calls, with optional filters by customer ID, from/to phone number, bot ID, date range, call status, and call type plus limit/offset pagination. With no filters it returns all calls; supply filters to narrow the set. Use to discover calls and their IDs. Read-only and idempotent.

markdown.description:
## Post-call Webhook Configuration

### Steps to Configure in OpenMic AI:
1. Open your bot in OpenMic AI
2. Click on the **Post-Call** tab
3. Go to the **Webhook** section
4. In the **Post-Call Webhook URL** field, paste the URL below:

```
{{webhookUrl}}
```

5. Save your configuration

[Learn more about post-call webhooks](https://docs.openmic.ai/post-call-webhook)

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an OpenMic AI call finishes, delivering the end-of-call report via the post-call webhook — including transcript, summary, duration, disconnection reason, success evaluation, and any extracted data. Requires the bot to be configured with the post-call webhook URL.

transcript: Hey Soumyadip! Great to hear from you. How can I help you today? Want me to reserve some raisins for you?
Awesome! I'll go ahead and reserve a pack of raisins for you at Shri Balaji Traders. Just let me know when you want to pick them up or if you'd like me to help with an online order. Cheers!

1. Abra seu bot no OpenMic AI
2. Clique na aba **Post-Call**
3. Vá para a seção **Webhook**
4. No campo **URL pós-chamada do Webhook **, cole a URL abaixo:

```
{{webhookUrl}}
```

5. Salve sua configuração
